target_claim: The constructive decomposition (S1..Sp = components of G[S], T1..Tq = components of G[T], Cij = the cut edges between Si and Tj) yields, for every non-empty Cij, a minimal cut (bond) of G. Source quote, lines 0060-0061: "Therefore, each non-empty Cij is a minimal cut, and we have expressed C as a disjoint union of minimal cuts."
failing_input: G = C4: V = {0,1,2,3}, E = {0-1, 1-2, 2-3, 3-0}; bipartition S = {0,2}, T = {1,3}. G[S] has components {0},{2}; G[T] has components {1},{3}; C = delta(S) = all four edges; the construction emits four non-empty singleton Cij, e.g. Si={0}, Tj={1} -> Cij = {0-1}.
observed_vs_claimed: Claimed: Cij = {0-1} is a minimal cut (bond) of G. Observed (brute-force oracle, exhaustive over all 2^4 vertex bipartitions): {0-1} is not delta(X) for ANY bipartition X, so it is not even a cut-set; #components(G) = 1 and #components(G - {0-1}) = 1, so its removal does not increase the component count either, failing both phrasings of the solution's own Definition 2. All 4 of the 4 non-empty Cij fail. The same failure recurs on C6 (6/6 bad) and C8 (8/8 bad) with the alternating bipartition. Exhaustive sweep over ALL labelled simple graphs crossed with ALL bipartitions: n=2 0/2 bad Cij, n=3 0/42, n=4 24/1130, n=5 3000/48740; and over all connected 6-vertex graphs with 6 or 7 edges, 194040/1262640 non-empty Cij are not minimal cuts.
faithfulness_notes: The construction is fully implementable as written and was implemented literally: components of G[S] and G[T] by DFS, C = delta(S) by Definition 1, Cij = cut edges with one endpoint in Si and one in Tj. Step 2's disjoint-union invariant (the Cij partition C) is asserted in code and holds on every instance tested, so only the Step 3 minimality/cut-set claim is at issue. The oracle uses only integer/set arithmetic (no floats): cut-set membership is decided by enumerating delta(X) over all 2^n-2 non-trivial bipartitions, and minimality by testing every non-empty proper subset of Cij for cut-set membership; the alternative 'removal increases the number of connected components' phrasing from Definition 2 is reported alongside and agrees. Both triage passes' sketches (K_{2,2} phrasing and C_{2k} alternating phrasing) were run explicitly and both refute. The proof's error is localized: line 0035 asserts 'Cij = delta(Si)', which is false as soon as Si sends cut edges to more than one Tj, and the minimality argument at lines 0052-0059 only considers paths between Si and Tj through Cij, ignoring paths through the rest of the graph. Everything is deterministic (no sampling, no seeds needed).
